title: Unit 1: Meeting Survival

exercises.why: 'Quick question' sent late afternoon with 'no rush' is universal executive camouflage for a high-severity crisis.

boss.hint: Try using phrases like: 'hard stop', 'bandwidth', 'circle back', 'take this offline', 'touch base', or 'parking lot'.

exercises.subject: Ecosystem Deep Dive
exercises.email: Disrupting the ecosystem from Zero to One requires a fundamental paradigm shift. We must move fast and break things while ruthlessly executing on our North Star metric.
options: Chadwick has an actionable, engineering-grounded technical spec.
Chadwick compressed 5 Silicon Valley clichés into two sentences to avoid sharing any actual strategy.
Chadwick is quitting his job to start a venture capital fund.
Chadwick wants the servers unplugged to break things literally.
exercises.why: A masterclass in buzzword salad: combining 'Zero to One', 'paradigm shift', 'move fast and break things', and 'North Star metric'.

exercises.subject: Founder Retrospective
exercises.email: Why I wake up at 3:45 AM, drink cold-pressed celery juice, take an ice bath, and deep dive into our North Star metric before my family wakes up. Agree?
options: A healthy, balanced wellness lifestyle recommended by medical professionals.
Unregulated LinkedIn hustle-porn designed to induce toxic productivity guilt. Agree?
An advertisement for celery farmers.
A company-wide calendar invite for morning meditation.
exercises.why: The archetype of LinkedIn performative hustle culture ending in the mandatory 'Agree?'

boss.title: The LinkedIn Phoenix
boss.prompt: You were abruptly let go this morning. Write a viral LinkedIn post reframing this severance event as an inspirational, transcendent milestone. Solicit engagement at the end!
boss.hint: Try using phrases like: 'humbled and thrilled', 'next chapter', 'agree?', 'open to new opportunities', 'paradigm shift', or 'game-changing milestone'.
